findings.detail: Microphone and Audio Input Capture use the same device. Both are unmuted; Desktop Audio also meters the program. The resulting mixed recording peaks at 0 dBFS. Mixer settings were not changed.
The Python application rendered 1168 frames in 104 seconds (11.23 fps); OBS output at 60 fps does not imply 60 unique application frames.
Blue explanatory line is inside the captured image (x=4..1271 of 1280) but has very narrow side margins.

audio_dropout_verdict: Inconclusive: the recording mixes duplicate/delayed audio paths; low-level comparison windows are candidates, not proof of hardware underrun. Native stream completed successfully with zero FM hard clips.
